extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: VAP-Data is the largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation, containing over 100K curated paired videos across 100 semantic conditions. It covers four primary categories—concept (entity transformation and interaction), style, motion (human and non-human), and camera movement—and was constructed using reference images paired with visual effects templates from commercial models and community LoRAs.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian; Xin Chen; Zenan Li; Tiancheng Zhi; Shen Sang; Linjie Luo; Qiang Xu
extraction.citeAs: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu. Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation. arXiv:2510.20888, October 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The authors curated 2K high-quality real images from the Internet, then used Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates, resulting in over 100K paired video samples across 100 semantic conditions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping; Software Collection; Secondary Data analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality real images collected from the Internet (spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases), processed through Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs (Civitai) to generate paired reference and target videos.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: A user study was conducted with 20 randomly selected video-generation researchers who evaluated video quality and semantic alignment. In each trial, raters compared outputs from different methods shown alongside a semantic-control reference video and chose the better result for (i) semantic alignment and (ii) overall quality.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Preference rate was computed as the normalized share of selections across all comparisons, totaling 100%, aggregating wins over all pairwise comparisons.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Gemini-2.5-Pro; GPT-5; VIDU; Kling; community LoRAs
extraction.rai:dataBiases: VAP-Data is synthetic and derived from other generative models (commercial APIs and community LoRAs), and may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., if the source models are poor at generating hands, VAP will likely not learn to generate hands well from this data)
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: VAP-Data is synthetic and derived from other generative models, which may inherit stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates; semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited and synthetic; building a large, real-world, semantic-controlled video dataset is beyond the paper's main focus; performance degrades when caption descriptions diverge or when subjects differ markedly between reference and target
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, deepfake content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media; mitigations include a research-only release and default content filters blocking clearly harmful categories (e.g., sexual content, explicit violence, hate symbols); VAP is not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Semantic-controlled video generation for research, education, and creative prototyping; training and evaluation of unified semantic-controlled video generation models across concept, style, motion, and camera conditions
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: VAP-Data was constructed by collecting 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet and then using Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to synthetically generate paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates, resulting in over 100K paired samples across 100 semantic conditions.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Reference images were curated from the Internet spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. Paired videos were created by matching each image to compatible visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs, with some templates restricting subject categories. For evaluation, 24 semantic conditions were evenly sampled from 4 categories with 2 samples each, totaling 48 test samples.
